extension: Append the frozen MultiVerS score to the twelve original views. Preserve the original features, conflict indicator, regularization values and selection objective. Include MultiVerS as an individual scoring form.
risk_grid_source: Quantiles of each fitted scoring form among fitting-query candidates within its first five ranks. Fix all thresholds before independent threshold-calibration labels are used. Bonferroni correction over 20 thresholds separately for each method and declared risk target.
risk_event: A query receives at least one sentence outside its annotated evidence set.
context_ablation: Use the same released fever_sci checkpoint and official tokenizer, collator and forward method. Compare the complete abstract against the title and each candidate sentence alone. Keep candidate identities and original query partitions fixed.
pool_extension: Evaluate the 500-candidate pool if the 100-candidate combination shows a usable positive result. Fit and calibrate again within the original predeclared partitions.
inference_precision: float16 autocast, matching the existing full-abstract scores
evaluation: Report every predeclared method and all four partitions, including unfavorable and empty-output results. Test labels do not select hyperparameters, scoring forms, risk thresholds or workload thresholds.
